Name: Hook Bazaar Confidential Marketplace System
Purpose: The purpose of the Hook Bazaar Confidential Marketplace System is to contribute to creating a sustainable marketplace for Uniswap v4 hooks where bytecode protection, functionality verification, and economic mechanisms ensure that purchasing licenses remains economically superior to decompiling code, despite public bytecode visibility on-chain.

Responsibilities.responsibility: It is the responsibility of the Hook Bazaar Confidential Marketplace System to protect hook bytecode intellectual property through Fhenix-based obfuscation and encryption, ensuring that decompilation attempts yield encrypted ciphertext rather than usable source code.
Responsibilities.description: The system must obfuscate hook bytecode for all parties using Fhenix encryption, deploy encrypted bytecode on-chain, and grant decryption keys only to licensed users. This responsibility addresses the core challenge of protecting intellectual property when bytecode is publicly visible.
Responsibilities.added_value: Enables developers to monetize hooks without code theft, creating economic incentives for continued development and innovation

Responsibilities.responsibility: It is the responsibility of the Hook Bazaar Confidential Marketplace System to enforce access control for auditors and researchers (who act as bonders), ensuring they can verify hook quality and functionality without leaking code information to unauthorized parties.
Responsibilities.description: The system must provide controlled access to clean hook code for auditors (security verification) and researchers (functionality verification) while implementing economic mechanisms (dual deposits, watermarking, reputation) that incentivize honest behavior and prevent information leakage.
business_goals: Enable quality verification without code leakage
Build trust through verified audits and research
Prevent auditor and researcher information leakage
Responsibilities.added_value: Reduces information asymmetry by providing verified quality assessments while protecting intellectual property, enabling protocol administrators to make informed decisions without direct code access

Responsibilities.responsibility: It is the responsibility of the Hook Bazaar Confidential Marketplace System to address information asymmetry for protocol administrators by providing automated compatibility analysis, proof of functionality, and simulation services without exposing raw code, enabling trust-based decision making with appropriate premium pricing.
Responsibilities.description: The system must perform automated analysis of hook compatibility based on pool state variables, generate proofs of functionality, provide simulation services where raw code is never visible, and verify state changes. This allows protocol administrators to evaluate hooks and make purchasing decisions despite information asymmetry, with the system commanding a premium for the trust and verification services provided.
business_goals: Justify premium pricing through trust services
Responsibilities.added_value: Enables protocol administrators to confidently purchase hooks based on verified functionality and compatibility without requiring direct code inspection, reducing transaction costs and enabling market efficiency

Responsibilities.responsibility: It is the responsibility of the Hook Bazaar Confidential Marketplace System to deploy purchased hook logic in isolated EVM environments that guarantee code obfuscation while fully granting functionality to the purchasing protocol.
Responsibilities.description: For each hook license purchase, the system must deploy the hook logic in an isolated EVM instance that ensures code obfuscation is maintained throughout execution, while providing full functional access to the licensed protocol. This isolated deployment prevents code leakage to other parties while ensuring the purchasing protocol receives complete functionality.
business_goals: Provide full functionality to licensed users
Responsibilities.added_value: Ensures licensed protocols receive complete hook functionality while maintaining intellectual property protection, creating clear value differentiation between licensed and unlicensed use

Responsibilities.responsibility: It is the responsibility of the Hook Bazaar Confidential Marketplace System to transform information asymmetry into trust premium through reputation systems, verification mechanisms, and value-added services that make purchasing licenses economically superior to decompilation.
Responsibilities.description: The system must implement reputation systems (PeerTrust-based), provide value-added services (documentation, audits, support), enable functionality verification, and create network effects that collectively make purchasing licenses more valuable than decompiling code, even when bytecode is publicly visible.
business_goals: Make purchasing economically superior to decompilation
Build trust and reduce transaction costs
Responsibilities.added_value: Creates conditions where honest market participation is the dominant strategy, ensuring long-term market sustainability and enabling continued innovation in the hook ecosystem

Exclusions.exclusion: The Hook Bazaar Confidential Marketplace System is not responsible for developing the hook code itself, only for protecting, verifying, and licensing existing hook implementations.
Exclusions.description: Hook development is the responsibility of hook developers. The system provides the marketplace infrastructure, protection mechanisms, and licensing framework, but does not create the hook logic or algorithms.
Exclusions.added_value: Focuses system scope on marketplace and protection mechanisms, allowing developers to innovate independently while leveraging the marketplace infrastructure

Exclusions.exclusion: The Hook Bazaar Confidential Marketplace System is not responsible for managing the underlying Uniswap v4 pool operations, liquidity provision, or swap execution beyond hook integration.
Exclusions.description: The system integrates hooks into Uniswap v4 pools but does not manage pool creation, liquidity provision, or swap mechanics. These remain the responsibility of protocol administrators and the Uniswap v4 protocol itself.
Exclusions.added_value: Maintains clear separation of concerns, allowing the marketplace to focus on hook licensing and protection while leveraging existing DeFi infrastructure

Exclusions.exclusion: The Hook Bazaar Confidential Marketplace System is not responsible for legal enforcement of license violations beyond on-chain mechanisms and economic penalties.
Exclusions.description: While the system implements on-chain detection and economic penalties (slashing, reputation loss) for license violations, it does not provide legal services, court representation, or off-chain legal enforcement. Legal action remains the responsibility of developers and their legal counsel.
Exclusions.added_value: Focuses on technical and economic mechanisms while providing the necessary on-chain evidence and verification that can support legal action if needed

Exclusions.exclusion: The Hook Bazaar Confidential Marketplace System is not responsible for providing direct customer support, bug fixes, or feature development for individual hooks beyond the marketplace infrastructure.
Exclusions.description: While the system facilitates hook discovery, licensing, and execution, it does not provide direct support for hook-specific issues, bug fixes, or feature requests. These remain the responsibility of individual hook developers who may offer support as part of their value proposition.
Exclusions.added_value: Maintains marketplace neutrality while enabling developers to differentiate through support offerings, creating competitive dynamics that benefit the ecosystem
